annotations.title: AI answer from web pages with verified quotes

description: AI question answering over 1 to 3 web page, PDF or DOCX URLs: grounded, cited RAG answers for research or fact checks. Pages are fetched with SSRF checks and read as Markdown (about the first 8k tokens each). Returns an answer of at most 150 words, claims with source URL and verbatim quote (checked in code against the page; unverified claims dropped) and confidence. 404, not charged, when the pages do not support an answer. AI-generated by Anthropic Claude. Price: $0.01 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged. AI-generated answer; a call with no arguments returns the stored example answer without a model call.

q.description: Question to answer from the pages, 3 to 300 characters. Answered only from the pages' text.
examples: What did the Declaration of Independence declare about the colonies and Great Britain?

urls.description: 1 to 3 comma-separated http or https URLs of public pages or documents (HTML, PDF, DOCX, ODT, plain text). Default ports only; credentials, IP addresses, localhost and private or single-label names are rejected.
